## Change

Describe the focused change and linked issue. Explain any effects on original retention, deletion consent, migration, dependencies or Android compatibility.

## Evidence

List exact commands and observed results, or explicitly state what was not run. Separate host tests/lint/builds from emulator, physical-device and signed-release checks. Use synthetic disposable fixtures; never attach private media or raw device logs.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant documentation and regression coverage updated (or explain why unchanged).
- [ ] No signing material, credentials, personal media or machine-specific configuration included.
- [ ] Published application/component identities and default original retention/explicit consent preserved.
- [ ] Historical recovery claims remain distinguished from current source and runtime evidence.
